recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. Any future decision to make AllergyIntolerance a direct CarePlan.addresses reference target would be a separate substantive Patient Care change because FHIR-13743 resolved to clarification rather than broadening the reference list.
issue_request: FHIR-13743 asked to add AllergyIntolerance, Observation, RiskAssessment, List, and possibly other resources to CarePlan.addresses. The Published Not Persuasive with Modification resolution instead kept CarePlan.addresses constrained to Condition and required explanatory text in Condition boundaries and CarePlan.addresses about representing allergy/intolerance conditions with AllergyIntolerance for decision support.
initial_application: Commit 32b35437cc8daef171fb42950801c6a39d6f918b applied the resolution in 2017 by adding the allergy/intolerance sentence to the old CarePlan spreadsheet comment and refining the Condition boundaries text. The Condition boundaries wording survived, but the CarePlan.addresses sentence was absent from the current StructureDefinition source after later source-format and CarePlan.addresses refactors.
additional_context: CarePlan and Condition are active current-build resources. Current CarePlan.addresses is CodeableReference with Condition, Procedure, and MedicationAdministration reference targets after later work including FHIR-32512; those later target changes do not add AllergyIntolerance as a direct target and do not supersede the FHIR-13743 clarification. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Added the missing allergy/intolerance guidance to source/careplan/structuredefinition-CarePlan.xml in the CarePlan.addresses comment, preserving the later CodeableReference concept/reference guidance and target profiles. Updated source/careplan/careplan-request-mapping-exceptions.xml with the same resource comment text so the parallel metadata stays consistent.
